messages:
alex: quick FYI — i'm opening a TF MR to change how we bind IAM for service account tokens used by external-secrets in each namespace. planning per-namespace SAs instead of one cluster SA.

maria: why the change? rotation or least-privilege?

alex: both. rotation: we want per-namespace token rotation and avoid wide-scoped SA. least-privilege: reduce blast radius when a secret controller is compromised.

samir: will this require changes to helm chart values for external-secrets?

alex: yes. Helm change will set `serviceAccount.create: true` and name the SA like `extsecrets-<ns>`. Also we need TF to create IAMBinding for each SA via for_each on namespaces.

jen: can you paste the TF pattern you plan to use?

alex: sure:
```
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "ext" {
  for_each = toset(var.namespaces)
  metadata {
    name      = "extsecrets-${each.key}"
    namespace = each.key
    annotations = {
      "iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account" = "sa-ext-${each.key}@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
    }
  }
}

resource "google_service_account_iam_binding" "ext" {
  for_each = toset(var.namespaces)
  service_account_id = "projects/${var.project}/serviceAccounts/sa-ext-${each.key}@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  role = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
  members = ["serviceAccount:${kubernetes_service_account.ext[each.key].metadata[0].name}@${each.key}"]
}
```

alex: (pseudo-demo, will refine with proper GCP identity format)

ops-oncall: careful with provider ordering — creating lots of per-namespace bindings caused API quota spikes in a previous deploy. maybe batch with `parallelism` or staged rollout.

maria: also ensure ExternalSecret CRs set `serviceAccountRef` to the new SA name. example annotation: `serviceAccount: extsecrets-<ns>`.

samir: for existing namespaces, do we need a migration? how to rotate tokens without downtime?

alex: plan: MR will add SA creation + binding and default ExternalSecret helm values. rollout plan:
1) Create SAs + IAM bindings (no svc restart)
2) Update ExternalSecrets to reference new SA (controller picks up)
3) Monitor syncs, if ok, remove cluster SA & old bindings.

jen: can we add feature-flag/policy so teams opt-in per-namespace?

alex: yes, helm value `serviceAccount.perNamespace: true` and default off. we'll expose a kustomize overlay for managed namespaces.

deploy-bot: preview env created: https://preview.rl/changes/1790123456

maria: LGTM. please include runbook for rollback and link to MR when ready. :thumbsup: 

ops-oncall: also add a smoke test that creates a dummy ExternalSecret and reads secret from SecretManager, include it in pipeline.

alex: thanks — will open MR in ~30m and ping here. tagging @jen for review.
